fact: The Education Sector Development Programme VI (2020/21 to 2024/25), published by the Federal Ministry of Education in 2021, states that schools do not yet have effective school management information systems (SMIS), that school reporting is paper-based and paperwork the norm in schools, and gives the baseline for 'availability of a student database' as None and for institutions networked for EMIS as 0; it plans a digital system for data on students' daily schooling (enrolment, attendance, assessment) with a unique identifier per student, and the integration of SMIS with EMIS.
title: Education Sector Development Programme VI (ESDP VI) 2013 – 2017 E.C. 2020/21 – 2024/25 G.C.
publisher: The Federal Ministry of Education, The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia
